findings: Qwen and Gemma produced six valid schema-conforming judgments and matched all six frozen expectations: corrected GCO and deliberate 999 to 660, kept clean 660 unchanged, recovered the full petition text including labor., and abstained for the no-image and mismatched-image controls.

Muse produced five valid judgments and one invalid schema: it emitted a reasoning wrapper {"self": ...} instead of the required fields on the petition case, so that case cannot be scored as a correct transcription despite its visible reasoning naming the right reading.

Muse abstained (uncertain) on both number corrections (original GCO and deliberate 999) because it judged the 90x58 pixel word-span crop too small/unclear, and labeled the clean control "correct" instead of "unchanged"; the transcribed text matched but the status contract did not.
Muse abstained correctly on the no-image and mismatched-page controls. It did not invent a reading.

Gemma and Qwen are tied on these six related controls; the sample cannot establish a general model winner. Muse is the weakest on this packet, principally showing small-crop sensitivity and JSON-contract leakage.
protocol_limitations: All three used JSON mode (schema spelled out in the prompt, strict Pydantic validation after the response), think=false, temperature0, 256 output tokens, 8192 context, one request at a time.
Muse retained visible chain-of-thought-like text in its content field on the petition case, which broke the schema; this is a model/protocol interaction, not salvaged or retried.
Abstention thresholds are model-specific: a small but legible 90x58 pixel crop was read by Qwen and Gemma but called too small by Muse.
No model response was applied to canonical OCR; expected labels were withheld from requests.
review_limitations: This harness (OpenCode big-pickle) cannot accept image input, so the comparison used the frozen source expectations and the earlier S0 agent visual diagnostic (artifacts/scans/scan-poc-20261024-01/review.json) for the printed 660/labor reading; no fresh independent visual re-check was performed here.
These six cases are related, output-informed feasibility controls, not representative held-out accuracy or human-reviewed gold.
next_decision: Do not expand this saturated six-case comparison. Next: bounded S0 checks (one crop each parts1/4/5 plus multiline/edge registration), then genuinely distinct uncertainty cases and an unreadable-image control before any selective-repair routing policy.
